content.title: Retail stocks slide, Tilray Brands earnings, Mattel downgrade
content.description:
Market Domination Host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma take a closer look at some of the trending tickers during Friday's session.

Retail stocks, like Under Armour (UAA, UA), Kohl's (KSS), and Lululemon (LULU), fell after the US Supreme Court didn't release a final ruling on President Trump's tariff policies that was expected on Friday.

Tilray Brands (TLRY) stock is in focus following the cannabis company's second quarter earnings results.

Goldman downgrades its rating on Mattel stock (MAT) to Neutral.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Consumer sentiment rises to 4-month high, retail stocks drop
content.description:
Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including retail stocks' reactions to the Supreme Court delaying their decision on President Trump's tariff policies, US consumer sentiment rising to its highest level since September 2025, and TD Cowen analysts forecast Chevron (CVX) could see a $700 million per year boost from Venezuelan oil production (CL=F, BZ=F).

content.title: A US Trader’s Guide to the Supreme Court’s Looming Tariff Ruling
content.summary: The equity market has extended its rise into the new year, with the S&P 500 Index hovering near a record.  Treasury yields have also come down from their mid-2025 peaks as traders bet the Federal Reserve will keep cutting rates while the economy cools.  If the nation’s top court says Trump exceeded his power with the blanket tariffs on countries around the globe, there will still be significant longer-term uncertainty, given that the White House could seek to re-impose similar levies by invoking different legal authority.
